policy.denominator: Published journal and conference/workshop entries; submitted manuscripts excluded.
policy.numericalSimulation: Includes analysis of existing simulation outputs, as confirmed by the author.
policy.observationalData: Includes quantitative comparison with observational measurements, including HELLO.
policy.representationLearning: Includes learned latent representations, including ICA and galactic archaeology.
policy.generalPhysics: Cross-scale category, not a larger physical size than cosmology.
policy.leastAction: Tabular Q-learning is tagged reinforcement learning, as requested by the author. Numerical simulation describes its numerical light-propagation environment; it does not use deep learning.
policy.roles: Author markers and highlights copied from the approved base CV. Submitted corresponding author unknown.
policy.ordering: Original category order and exact date audit preserved.
policy.authorNames: Full given names and family names verified against primary bylines. Published middle initials retained where not expanded by a verified source; no guessed expansion. Accents retained. Yuxi (Lucy) Lu follows the galactic-archaeology byline; formatting normalized with a space before the parenthesis.
policy.chineseNames: Use user-confirmed spellings or Chinese characters explicitly published by the same researcher or a primary institutional/event source. Do not infer ethnicity or transliterate names. Preserve the verified script, including traditional characters.

institutions.scope: Affiliations printed on the 15 published papers, not current affiliations; submitted manuscripts excluded. Confirmed by the author on 2026-11-05.
institutions.count: Unique institution IDs across every published author-paper affiliation. Multiple affiliations are included; repeated institutions across authors and papers count once.
institutions.normalization: Departments and subordinate centers count under their university or institute. NYU Abu Dhabi and NYU New York count once as New York University. Heidelberg IWR/ITA and NYU CASS/CAP3 are merged with their universities.
institutions.institutes: Named research institutes remain separate, including Ciela, Mila, Flatiron, MPIA, IASF-Milano, INAF Torino, INFN Padova, and individual national-academy observatories. A shared national umbrella alone does not merge institutes.
institutions.cifar: CIFAR AI Chair and CIFAR Senior Fellow byline affiliations count as one CIFAR organizational affiliation, not two institutions or a claim of a physical workplace.
institutions.provenance: Original affiliation strings, author-to-affiliation labels, and primary-source URLs are retained per paper in affiliationAudit.
